## ProofService.createProposalAsResponse() method

Create a [ProposePresentationMessage](./core.proposepresentationmessage.md) as response to a received presentation request. To create a proposal not bound to an existing presentation exchange, use [ProofService.createProposal()](./core.proofservice.createproposal.md).

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
createProposalAsResponse(proofRecord: ProofRecord, presentationProposal: PresentationPreview, config?: {
        comment?: string;
    }): Promise<ProofProtocolMsgReturnType<ProposePresentationMessage>>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter            | Type                                                 | Description                                                        |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| proofRecord          | [ProofRecord](./core.proofrecord.md)                 | The proof record for which to create the presentation proposal     |
| presentationProposal | [PresentationPreview](./core.presentationpreview.md) | The presentation proposal to include in the message                |
| config               | { comment?: string; }                                | <i>(Optional)</i> Additional configuration to use for the proposal |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[ProofProtocolMsgReturnType](./core.proofprotocolmsgreturntype.md)&lt;[ProposePresentationMessage](./core.proposepresentationmessage.md)&gt;&gt;

Object containing proposal message and associated proof record
